description: Upload a lab-report PDF or scan (by HTTPS URL) and trigger Mediora.AI's full Vision + analysis pipeline. Returns a pending test id the client can poll. The URL must be https, must resolve to a public IP (no localhost / cloud-metadata / private LAN), and the file must be PDF / JPEG / PNG ≤ 10 MB. Redirects are not followed — pass the final URL.

file_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the lab-report PDF to analyze.

language.description: Preferred language for the analysis output. Defaults to 'en'.

name: mediora__analyze_lab_pdf
title: Analyze a lab report
